title: Special Topics in Information Studies; UX Business Basics
description: Explore the business side of UX design and what it takes to successfully bring products to market and take a product from ideation through prototype of a minimum viable product (MVP) while also assessing risks and defining metrics for product success. Topics include project management, project scope, problem identification, market research, and how to effectively communicate research findings to various stakeholders and teams as well as presentation skills and building winning pitch decks for funding.
